name: Peralejos de Abajo (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a yellow saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peralejos de Abajo (a tree on yellow and pears on green).
history: The municipal flag is square, of proportions 1:1, formed of a green cloth with a yellow saltire, with the local arms centred and superimposed.

features.role: Peralejos de Abajo arms — tree on yellow and pears on green
cap of the crown of the arms
